title: Carved in Stone, Held in Light
text:
Look closely at the carved surfaces and the rising form of Jagdish Temple. This sample introduction invites you to notice the architectural details before exploring the surrounding streets.

This is editorial sample content, not a verified history of the temple. Dates, patrons and architectural claims require source review before publication.
